import { Order } from './Order';
import { OrderStatus } from './OrderStatus';

export interface OrderRepository {
  nextId(): string;
  findById(id: string): Order | undefined;
  findByStatus(status: OrderStatus): Order[];
  save(order: Order): void;
}
